Q5100.reason: Prior gun violence made a shooting that injured the next-door neighbor foreseeable, so the owner’s failure to evict supports liability; mere knowledge of drug dealing is not enough and there is no blanket immunity for third-party crime.

Q5421.reason: Intramuscular ATP alone lasts only about 1–2 seconds of maximal work; about 10 seconds is the combined ATP–phosphocreatine system, and the muscle ATP reserve is small.

Q8166.reason: Maine’s “hitherto” makes the aphorism a historical observation about progressive societies, but it is commonly misread as a prediction or necessary law of progress.
